title: Google AI Search Doubles in a Year: 43% of Search Results Now Have AI Overview, Traditional Web Pages Are Being Replaced by Direct Answers

content_html:
Similarweb's latest report reveals an undeniable trend: AI search is rapidly reshaping traditional search experiences. The presence of Google's AI Overview in search results has increased from 15% a year ago to 43%, and AI-driven information retrieval is quietly becoming the default user experience.

Data shows that traffic to Google's AI mode rose from 126 million in June 2025 to 279 million in May 2026, more than doubling. At the same time, user search behavior is also undergoing a fundamental change — more people are beginning to use longer, more natural conversational queries, replacing the short keyword-based searches of the past. Searching is shifting from "helping users find web pages" to "providing answers directly to users."

References have increased fivefold, but traffic does not necessarily follow

This change has profoundly affected the logic of internet traffic distribution. Traditional publishers and content websites are facing the dilemma of AI summaries "siphoning" traffic — users may get answers directly on the search results page without even clicking into the original web page.

Data shows that the number of search responses containing AI references has grown more than fivefold over the past year, but references do not equal traffic. For example, in the U.S. market, only 6.8% of desktop search queries on ChatGPT as of May 2026 included reference links. However, there are significant differences across industries — travel, retail, and sports sectors are more likely to gain AI search references, and these areas benefit more significantly in terms of traffic.

For content creators, it's not all bad news. After ChatGPT's search update on May 7, 2026, the web recommendation traffic from ChatGPT to U.S. desktop users improved significantly — by the end of May, the percentage of web visits increased from 25% to nearly 60%. This means that when AI products begin to prioritize references and traffic redirection, the content ecosystem still has room for recovery.

From a navigation tool to a consumption platform, Google's identity has changed

In general, AI search is driving a structural transformation in internet access points. Google has shifted from a traditional "web navigation tool" to an "information consumption platform," and the search results page is no longer just a list of links, but a destination for direct information delivery.

For websites and content organizations, the rules of the game have been rewritten. Optimizing content structure and AI visibility in an AI-driven information distribution model will determine the next phase of the content competition landscape. The traditional model that heavily relied on search traffic is being slowly dismantled by an invisible revolution.

content_html_zh:
Sameweb的最新报告揭示了一个不可否认的趋势：人工智能搜索正在迅速重塑传统搜索体验。 谷歌的AI Overview在搜索结果中的出现率已从一年前的15%增加到43%，AI驱动的信息检索正悄然成为默认的用户体验。

数据显示，谷歌AI模式的流量从2025年6月的1.26亿增长到2026年5月的2.79亿，增长了一倍多。 与此同时，用户的搜索行为也正在发生根本性的变化——越来越多的人开始使用更长、更自然的对话式查询，取代过去基于关键词的简短搜索。 搜索正在从“帮助用户查找网页”转向“直接向用户提供答案”。

引用量增加了五倍，但流量不一定随之增加

这一变化深刻影响了互联网流量分配的逻辑。 传统出版商和内容网站面临着人工智能摘要“吸走”流量的困境——用户甚至不需要点击原始网页，就可以直接在搜索结果页面上得到答案。

数据显示，包含人工智能参考的搜索响应数量在过去一年中增长了五倍多，但参考并不等于流量。 例如，在美国市场，截至 2026 年 5 月，ChatGPT 上的桌面搜索查询中只有 6.8% 包含参考链接。 但不同行业之间存在显着差异——旅游、零售、体育等行业更容易获得AI搜索参考，这些领域在流量方面受益更为显着。

对于内容创作者来说，这并不全是坏消息。 2026 年 5 月 7 日 ChatGPT 搜索更新后，ChatGPT 向美国桌面用户的网页推荐流量显着改善——截至 5 月底，网页访问比例从 25% 增加到近 60%。 这意味着，当AI产品开始优先考虑引用和流量重定向时，内容生态系统仍有恢复的空间。

从导航工具到消费平台，谷歌的身份发生了变化

总的来说，人工智能搜索正在推动互联网接入点的结构转型。 谷歌已经从传统的“网络导航工具”转变为“信息消费平台”，搜索结果页面不再仅仅是链接列表，而是直接信息传递的目的地。

对于网站和内容组织来说，游戏规则已经被改写。 在人工智能驱动的信息分发模型中优化内容结构和人工智能可视性将决定下一阶段的内容竞争格局。 严重依赖搜索流量的传统模式正在被一场无形的革命慢慢瓦解。
